title: Train and compare a SigLIP model

summary: Take a qualified text or cross-modal encoder through exact search, approximate indexes, hybrid retrieval, reranking, evaluation and safe index migration.

summary: MLM to contrastive pretraining and retrieval fine-tuning, with frozen data, MTEB evaluation and release gates.

title: Build a causal language model
summary: Connect tokenizer/data preparation, next-token pretraining, adaptation, generation evaluation and model publication.

title: Build an image understanding model
summary: Carry a frozen image recipe through representation learning, task adaptation and measured evaluation.

title: Build an image generation pipeline
summary: Qualify image representations, denoising training, conditioning and sampling with separate quality and runtime evidence.

title: Build an audio understanding model
summary: Version waveform and acoustic representations through training, recognition or event adaptation and robustness evaluation.

title: Build an audio generation pipeline
summary: Connect codec qualification, sequence or denoising training, conditioning and waveform evaluation.

title: Build a grounded multimodal model
summary: Qualify encoders, connector alignment, instruction adaptation and grounded evaluation, keeping retrieval a distinct outcome.
